correctness.rationale: The two-edge-gap facet normal form is inherited explicitly from Proposition 8.3 and independently reconstructed. A nontrivial rotation-invariant face cannot mix signs; the quotient support must omit neighboring residues. Signed permutation parity cancels d and leaves (-1)^(s-1). Transfer-matrix trace with eigenvalues exp(±iπ/3) gives the uniform 5/-1 character. Identity follows from Theorem 8.6. Rational positivity and the absence of the order-two character imply the graded C_n decomposition for multiples of three. A standalone complete finite-face verifier checks 51 cases n=6..11, not an infinite proof.
